title: Partner Sentence · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Partner Sentence · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and an everyday topic. One player says a first sentence and the partner adds a second sentence that follows it. The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Partner Sentence, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group can understand how the second sentence follows the first.
